desc:
Halloween Update

Claim your own private island and build it from an empty plot into a millionaire's paradise! Play solo or team up with a friend to share an island and earn together.

💰 Buy droppers, upgrades and buildings to grow your cash empire
🏰 Rebirth to go from a Villa to a Mega Villa to a Royal Palace, with bigger earnings each time
🌊 Race jet skis around the island for a timed cash boost
🐯 Earn gems from missions to unlock pets, trails and auras, including Champ the Bengal Tiger
🎯 Complete daily and weekly missions and keep your streak going
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for Most Money and Most Rebirths
👑 Get VIP for bonus cash and extra perks

Grab an island before they're gone. Only 6 per server! 🌴

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for updates!
